lesson.title: SMAW Lap and T Joint Teaching Review
learningTargets: I am learning to identify lap and T joints and explain where a fillet weld belongs.
successCriteria: I can identify the joint and my current work target.

preparation: Confirm the approved setup, PPE, ventilation, samples, and safe waiting work before students begin.

sharedInstruction.summary: Use a short shared explanation and demonstration, then return students to the appropriate work for their current need.
demonstrationSteps: Identify the joint and intended weld location.
Model one controlled attempt and one useful comparison.
questions: What will you check first, and why?
safetyPrompts: Students begin only work for which the required setup, supervision, and safety expectations are in place.

pathways.title: Arc starting and control
pathways.useWhen: Use when a learner needs prerequisite arc control instruction.
pathways.task: Practice the approved start and a short controlled section on plate.
pathways.instructorFocus: Narrow the immediate goal and change one variable at a time.
lookFors: The learner can start and maintain the arc with the available support.
safetyPrompts: Live work requires the approved setup and instructor supervision.

helpSections.title: Practice loop
body: Attempt, inspect, agree on one change, try again, and compare.

pathways.title: Supported lap-joint work
pathways.useWhen: Use when a learner can participate safely but still needs coaching.
pathways.task: Show the movement on a cold sample, then complete a short supported attempt.
pathways.instructorFocus: Choose one observed target: placement, angle, arc length, or travel.
coachingSteps: Check fit-up and intended weld location.
Reduce prompts as the skill becomes more consistent.
questions: What is the one change for the next attempt?
lookFors: The learner can identify one improvement and one remaining concern.
safetyPrompts: Keep all other approved setup variables stable while coaching one change.

helpSections.title: When explanation is not enough
body: Provide another short demonstration and compare the next attempt.

pathways.title: Independent lap-joint practice
pathways.useWhen: Use for a learner already cleared for that specific practice.
pathways.task: Complete the approved practice, inspect it against the reference, and identify the next adjustment.
pathways.instructorFocus: Use periodic technique checks rather than approving every bead.
coachingSteps: Arrange an instructor check when observation suggests readiness.
questions: What did you keep steady here?
lookFors: The learner justifies a specific self-correction.
safetyPrompts: Clearance for this practice does not authorize a new operation or setup.

helpSections.title: Actionable feedback
body: Name the visible improvement and ask the learner to repeat the useful control.

pathways.title: T-joint next step
pathways.useWhen: Use when a learner is ready for an instructor-checked next task.
pathways.task: Compare the lap and T joint, then complete the approved first T-joint practice.
pathways.instructorFocus: Teach what stays the same and what changes with the joint.
coachingSteps: Demonstrate the appropriate setup and technique.
Check fit-up and intended weld location before live work.
questions: What stays the same from the lap joint, and what changes?
lookFors: The learner identifies one adjustment needed for the new task.
safetyPrompts: A next step is not automatic permission for new equipment, positions, or fabrication.

helpSections.title: First-task support
body: Provide substantial help when needed without describing the learner as going backward.
